# LED bars

Three small PCBs around the display: one **top** bar (12 LEDs) and two
**side** bars (4 LEDs each, same board). Generated by `build.py` with
KiCad 7; design rule check runs as part of the build (0 errors required).

```
python3.12 hardware/ledbar/build.py   # needs KiCad 7 (apt install kicad)
```

## Ordering at PCBWay (PCB + assembly)

Per board, upload from `out/<board>/`:

| File | Where in the PCBWay form |
|------|--------------------------|
| `gerbers.zip` | "Quote & Order → PCB Instant Quote → Add Gerber file" |
| `bom.csv` | PCB Assembly → BOM |
| `cpl.csv` | PCB Assembly → Centroid / Pick & Place |

Settings (everything else default):

| Setting | top | side |
|---------|-----|------|
| Size | 104 × 12 mm | 43 × 12 mm |
| Quantity | 5 (minimum) | 10 (2 per display) |
| Layers | 2 | 2 |
| Thickness | **1.0 mm** (case is designed for it) | **1.0 mm** |
| Solder mask | black (no light bleed) | black |
| Silkscreen | white | white |
| Surface finish | HASL lead free | HASL lead free |
| Assembly | Turnkey, top side only | Turnkey, top side only |

PCBWay sends a DFM / part-orientation review before production — check that
pin 1 of each LED (marked corner) matches the "1" on the silkscreen.

## Electrical

- WS2812B-B 5050 LEDs, 100 nF per LED, 5 V rail on top copper, solid GND
  plane on the bottom.
- Side bar: LED 1 is powered through D1 (1N4148W, ≈ 0.7 V drop) so it reads
  the ESP32's 3.3 V data reliably and re-drives full 5 V levels down the
  chain — no level-shifter chip needed. 330 Ω series resistor at every input.
- Wire pads: **IN** (G, D, 5V) at one end, **OUT** (G, D, 5V) at the other;
  labels are on the back silkscreen.

## Chain and mounting

```
            top bar (IN left → OUT right)
   ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
   │ OUT                                      │ IN
 left bar        display window          right bar
 (IN bottom,                              (IN top,
  chain up)                                chain down)
   │ IN                                       │ OUT (end)
   └── from ESP32: 5V, GND, data (GPIO6)
```

Left bar OUT → top bar IN, top bar OUT → right bar IN: three short wires each.
LEDs face the front plate; the display glass rests on the back of the top bar.
